A girl, sat in the middle of the ocean, upon the small remnants of a once great ship, her bare legs dangling in the sea. The wooden planks, scarred and blackened, as if a giant had tried to chew the ship apart. Poison and blood, painting a story of horror, on a canvas of wood. The girl was not pleased. Yet she was pleased. It was complex. She straitened a leg, and played with her toes, rippling the surface.

'Damn you Tempest, you're too impulsive' said the girl, to no one. She tried to stand, but the flotsam had different ideas. The small raft rocking back and forth, threatening to topple. Gently the girl, with an unexpected grace, stood. One last look around, and she stepped off the raft.

She fell into the sea, but the sea was different. Turquoise and clear, she fell into the centre of Ikagoya. There before her, rested the pearl. The essence of Tempest, a force of power, that she desired. She put her hand to the pearl, and a tempest came flooding out. A force of being, a force of power, it struck her, with pure emotion. Rage and serenity, action and stillness, hate and love, fluctuating in a dance, within her, within the pearl.

Zille smiled, for she knew that rage, she knew that love. To love Tempest, you accepted both, you accepted the dichotomy, of a being, that would tear you apart, and protect you at the same time. It was her turn to be like Tempest, for she loved to take and give, in the same action. The oceans would need her protection, their spirit, now shared amongst the Seafairers, was vulnerable in a new way.

Zille's hand broke the surface of the pearl, and the whole of Ikagoya shook. Upon the sea's and oceans of Gaea, a great storm grew. Zille felt Tempest come flooding in, her body, her being, mingled with his. Two forces colliding in ecstasy, for a moment, Tempest was present.

He took her, his force overwhelming hers, trying to tear her apart, trying to hold her together, a simultaneous eradication of her being. A wave of agony rising within her, only to be replaced with a wave of ecstasy, like the ocean waves, colliding with the shore, one after the other, never retreating. The pearl began to draw her in, calling to her, whispering, 'be with me my love. Forever'.

Her entire arm drawn into the pearl, ecstasy filled her. Always with Tempest, the threat of drowning. Zille's eyes cleared, and she focused. She withdrew herself. In her hand, she held three fist sized pearls. The seed of tempest.
